about_the_game:
A Casual Roguelite

"DeviDevi Survivor" is an action game that combines omnidirectional shooting with roguelite elements.

Players take on the role of a protagonist who seeks to fulfill wishes using the power of the scales, challenging evil spirits.

Through stage-based adventures, players can enjoy character growth and evolution.

Unique Evolution System

Due to the curse of the scales, the protagonist's body, stats, and character portrait change after clearing each stage.

This evolution system allows players to experience different growth patterns in each playthrough.

Rich Skills and Strategy

Over 40 different skills are available, and players can choose random skills when leveling up.

This allows players to build their own ultimate character.

Combine skills to develop various tactics and face hordes of evil spirits approaching from all directions.

Multiple Endings

The story branches based on changes in the protagonist's body type, leading to different endings.

Each growth phase has dedicated event scenes, allowing players to enjoy story developments according to their chosen growth pattern.

The protagonist's body type at the time of game completion is directly reflected in the ending scene, allowing for a more immersive conclusion.

※By clearing "Hard" difficulty, you can unlock the archive function that allows you to view all scene animations and body variations.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are 20 years of age or older. 
The game contains adult content, including nudity and sexual activities. 
Additionally, parts of the body may grow or change based on the player's in-game actions.
